data.gender_notes: Divij is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Divij is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'diva' meaning 'sky' or 'heaven'. It is a name with deep spiritual significance in Hindu mythology, often given to children born on auspicious days or during significant celestial events. The name Divij carries the meaning “Sky or Heaven” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Divij usually hope their child will grow to embody sky or heaven and live with faith, good character and purpose.
